abstract: This article examines the effect of the CEO’s gender on a firm’s employment decisions, focusing on its investment in lower-level female workers. Using a sample of Korean public companies, we demonstrate that firms with female CEOs have a higher proportion of female workers than those with male CEOs. The regression results also suggest that these firms hire female workers at a higher rate than expected, resulting in a greater disparity between the actual and projected net hiring of women. We confirm that the influence of female CEOs on gender diversity at the lower level is robust to the proportion of female directors and various model specifications to mitigate industry bias and endogeneity problem.
title: Female CEOs and employee gender diversity: evidence from Korea

abstract: Over the past decade, the United States has experienced a significant productivity advantage over the European Union, leading to a widening productivity gap. This divergence is characterized by a rapid shift towards intangible investment and rising markups in the US economy relative to the EU. Also, existing studies have predominantly focused on the US, often neglecting the role of intangible capital in shaping both productivity and markup dynamics, as well as their measurement. This paper addresses this gap by integrating intangibles and markups into a macroeconomic productivity framework, examining their interaction and their contribution to the EU-US productivity divide. Using EUKLEMS&INTANProd panel data, we estimate the impact of intangible investments on productivity in a framework considering also their links with markups. Our results show that: 1) properly accounting for intangibles implies lower estimated markups, particularly in the US and in high intangible-intensive sectors; 2) the US’ robust productivity growth can be partially attributed to earlier and more significant investments in intangible assets, which also helps explain the observed dynamics in markups; 3) in contrast, the EU lags in intangible capital and shows less significant markup trends.
title: Understanding productivity gaps: the nexus between intangible capital and market power

abstract: In this paper, we construct the association networks of listed companies through the LASSO-VAR model and generalized impulse response function, on this basis, using the financial data of Chinese-listed companies from 2010 to 2021, we quantify the role of association network transmission mechanisms in the transmission of stock liquidity through the spatial panel autoregressive (SPAR) model. The findings reveal four key insights: First, the association network transmission mechanism plays an important part in the impact of companies’ digital transformation on stock liquidity, with a contribution share of about 79%. Second, digital transformation has a higher effect on the stock liquidity level of non-state-owned companies than state-owned companies; digital transformation has a higher effect on the stock liquidity level of high-tech companies than non-high-tech companies, with network transmission mechanisms playing a more significant role. Third, companies that fail in digital transformation have a negative impact on stock liquidity. Fourth，there is a cognitive constraint on the impact of digital transformation on equity liquidity, as investors are overwhelmed by the increasing volume and complexity of unstructured information, leading to a decline in equity liquidity.

title: Corporate digital transformation and equity liquidity under association network transmission mechanisms

abstract: This study examines the debt service ratio (DSR) as a predictor of household financial distress in South Korea, with a particular focus on identifying the threshold at which delinquency risk rises sharply. Leveraging household-level microdata and a multilevel Bayesian threshold regression model, we estimate the tipping point in the DSR – default relationship while accounting for household heterogeneity. Our findings indicate that the critical DSR threshold falls below current regulatory benchmarks, suggesting that many households may experience financial strain at lower debt levels than anticipated by policymakers. Notably, we find substantial variation by employment type: temporary and self-employed workers exhibit significantly higher vulnerability, even at moderate DSRs. These results highlight the limitations of uniform regulatory caps and support the need for differentiated, evidence-based lending standards. By offering the first data-driven estimate of DSR thresholds in Korea, this study advances the academic understanding of household credit risk and informs ongoing macroprudential policy development. KEYWORDS: Debt service ratio Delinquency financial stability multilevel bayesian model JEL CLASSIFICATION: G51 C11 D14 G21
abstract_zh: 本研究以韩国为对象，考察偿债比率（DSR）作为家庭财务困境预测指标的有效性，重点识别违约风险急剧上升的阈值。通过运用家庭层面微观数据与多层贝叶斯阈值回归模型，我们在考虑家庭异质性的基础上，估算了DSR与违约关系中的临界点。研究结果表明，关键DSR阈值低于现行监管基准，这意味着许多家庭在债务水平低于政策制定者预期时便可能面临财务压力。值得注意的是，不同就业类型之间存在显著差异：临时工与自雇劳动者即使在中等DSR水平下也表现出明显更高的脆弱性。这些结果揭示了统一监管上限的局限性，并支持制定差异化、基于证据的贷款标准。通过首次提供韩国DSR阈值的数据驱动估计，本研究深化了对家庭信用风险的学术理解，并为当前宏观审慎政策的发展提供参考。关键词：偿债比率；违约；金融稳定；多层贝叶斯模型 JEL分类：G51；C11；D14；G21
title: DSR and Household debt delinquency: evidence from South Korea
title_zh: DSR与家庭债务违约：来自韩国的证据

abstract: This study examines the impact of the ‘integration of informatization and industrialization’ (III) pilot policy on corporate ESG (environmental, social, and governance) performance. Utilizing unbalanced panel data from Chinese listed companies spanning 2010–2022, we construct a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) model for empirical analysis. The results demonstrate that the III pilot policy significantly enhances corporate ESG performance, with findings remaining robust across a series of rigorous tests. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the policy’s positive effects are more pronounced in eastern and central China compared with western regions. The policy also consistently improves ESG performance across corporate life cycles – growth, maturity, and decline stages – although the magnitude varies. Notably, heavily polluting and technology-intensive industries exhibit stronger ESG improvements under the policy. Additional mechanism analyses indicate that green technology innovation capabilities, labour productivity levels, and government support collectively form a positive feedback loop in mediating the policy’s impact on ESG outcomes. Our research provides novel policy-level evidence for advancing corporate ESG practices.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了“两化融合”（III）试点政策对企业ESG（环境、社会和治理）绩效的影响。基于2010—2022年中国上市公司非平衡面板数据，构建多期双重差分（DID）模型进行实证分析。结果表明，III试点政策显著提升了企业ESG绩效，该结论在一系列严格检验中保持稳健。异质性分析显示，相较于西部地区，该政策在东部和中部地区的积极效应更为显著。政策在企业生命周期各阶段（成长期、成熟期和衰退期）均能持续改善ESG绩效，但影响幅度存在差异。值得注意的是，重污染行业和技术密集型行业在政策作用下表现出更强的ESG改善效果。进一步机制分析表明，绿色技术创新能力、劳动生产率水平和政府支持共同构成正向反馈循环，中介了政策对ESG结果的影响。本研究为推进企业ESG实践提供了新的政策层面证据。
authors: Zelin Yuan Chee-Wooi Hooy Yike Sun Baoliu Liu a School of Finance and Accounting
Fuzhou University of International Studies and Trade, Fuzhou

title: Digital technology transformation and corporate ESG performance: evidence from the “integration of informatization and industrialization” pilot zone

abstract: To preserve a competitive edge and protect proprietary information, companies may strategically design their ESG disclosures in line with product market competition (PMC). This study aims to examine how the moderating role of PMC influences the relationship between sustainable practices and ‘firm financial performance’ (FFP). Using regression techniques on a sample of 2801 firms from G-20 countries over a study period covering from 2011 to 2023, findings show that firms’ sustainable practices positively impact FFP. PMC effectively acts as a disciplinary mechanism for firm’s performance and aligns with the deterrence hypothesis. Due to competitive pressure, sustainable practices increase firm performance. Although in all cases, PMC does not portray moderating effect to establish relationship between sustainable practices and firm value, the individual parameters, such as environmental and social practices, are enhancing FFP under high PMC levels. While in low competition, environmental practices detriment FFP due to competitive disadvantages. Further, in developed countries, PMC is ineffective, whereas it effectively works for developing countries. Using alternative competition measures, sensitivity analysis, and propensity score matching, the present study provides robust empirical evidence to validate the moderating role of PMC in shaping ESG-FFP dynamics. Managers may leverage PMC strategically; investors and policymakers ought to keep on surveillance for greenwashing.
abstract_zh: 为保持竞争优势并保护专有信息，企业可能根据产品市场竞争（PMC）策略性地设计其ESG披露。本研究旨在探讨PMC的调节作用如何影响可持续实践与企业财务绩效（FFP）之间的关系。基于2011至2023年间G20国家2801家企业的样本数据，采用回归分析发现：企业可持续实践对FFP具有正向影响。PMC有效发挥企业绩效的惩戒机制作用，与威慑假说一致。在竞争压力下，可持续实践提升了企业绩效。尽管在所有情形中PMC均未表现出调节可持续实践与企业价值关系的效应，但在高PMC水平下，环境与社会实践等单项指标均能提升FFP；而在低竞争环境下，环境实践因竞争劣势反而损害FFP。此外，PMC在发达国家中调节效应不显著，但在发展中国家表现有效。通过采用替代竞争指标、敏感性分析和倾向得分匹配，本研究为PMC在ESG-FFP动态关系中的调节作用提供了稳健的实证证据。管理者可策略性运用PMC；投资者与政策制定者需持续警惕漂绿行为。
authors: Rajesh Bhue Ajaya Kumar Panda Mainak Mazumdar a Finance and Economics
title: Does competition drive the sustainability and financial performance of firms? Evidence from G-20 nations
title_zh: 竞争是否驱动企业的可持续性与财务绩效？来自G20国家的证据
